filingRisks.title: Financial and liquidity risk
filingRisks.detail: The filing reports that could result in a material reduction in its net sales in its eCommerce operations, as well as in its stores, thereby materially adversely affecting its operations, net sales, growth rates, operating income, results of operations, financial position, cash flows and liquidity.
evidence: could result in a material reduction in our net sales in our eCommerce operations, as well as in our stores, thereby materially adversely affecting our operations, net sales, growth rates, operating income, results of operations, financial position, cash flows and liquidity.

Changes in third-party reimbursements and contracts, type, or scope of offerings of our health and wellness business could adversely affect our overall results of operations, cash flows and liquidity.

filingRisks.title: People and execution
filingRisks.detail: The filing reports that these incidents may involve the company, its vendors that handle its data or personal information, its workforce or others with whom the company does business, including third-party service providers and independent contractors.
evidence: These incidents may involve us, our vendors that handle our data or personal information, our workforce or others with whom we do business, including third-party service providers and independent contractors.

Increased competition among potential employers at all levels, including senior management and executive levels, could result in increased associate costs or make it more difficult to recruit and retain associates.

filingRisks.title: Competition and innovation
filingRisks.detail: The filing reports that the success of its business depends in part on how accurately the company predict consumer demand, availability of merchandise, the related impact on the demand for existing products and services and the competitive environment.
evidence: The success of our business depends in part on how accurately we predict consumer demand, availability of merchandise, the related impact on the demand for existing products and services and the competitive environment.
In addition, for eCommerce and other internet-based businesses, newer or smaller businesses may be better able to innovate and compete with us.

filingRisks.title: Cybersecurity and data privacy
filingRisks.detail: The filing reports that AI search and discovery results, or a data breach as a result of a cyberattack could quickly erode trust and confidence in its business and could result in customer dissatisfaction, consumer boycotts, workforce unrest and government investigations.
evidence: AI search and discovery results, or a data breach as a result of a cyberattack could quickly erode trust and confidence in our business and could result in customer dissatisfaction, consumer boycotts, workforce unrest and government investigations.

We cannot be certain that the security measures we or our third-party suppliers maintain are able to detect, prevent or contain cyberattacks, cyberterrorism, security incidents, breaches or other compromises from malware, ransomware or other threats that are known or may be developed in the future.

filingRisks.title: Macroeconomic conditions and demand
filingRisks.detail: The filing reports that moreover, failure to adequately predict customer demand and consumer spending patterns or otherwise optimize and operate its distribution and fulfillment centers could result in excess or insufficient inventory, service interruptions and increased costs, any of which could significantly harm its business.
evidence: Moreover, failure to adequately predict customer demand and consumer spending patterns or otherwise optimize and operate our distribution and fulfillment centers could result in excess or insufficient inventory, service interruptions and increased costs, any of which could significantly harm our business.

In the event of any global or regional health crisis, customer demand for certain products may fluctuate, customer behaviors may change and consumer disposable income could be negatively impacted, which may challenge our ability to anticipate and/or adjust inventory levels to meet that demand.

filingRisks.title: International and geopolitical exposure
filingRisks.detail: The filing reports that natural disasters, climate change, geopolitical events, catastrophic and other events could materially adversely affect its financial performance.
evidence: Natural disasters, climate change, geopolitical events, catastrophic and other events could materially adversely affect our financial performance.

The various risks inherent in doing business in the U.S. generally also exist when doing business outside of the U.S., and may be exaggerated by the difficulty of doing business in numerous sovereign jurisdictions due to differences in culture, geopolitical tensions or events, laws and regulations.

filingRisks.title: Supply chain and operations
filingRisks.detail: The filing reports that these and other factors affecting its suppliers, its access to products and its access to service providers (such as transportation and logistics providers) could adversely affect its operations and financial performance.
evidence: These and other factors affecting our suppliers, our access to products and our access to service providers (such as transportation and logistics providers) could adversely affect our operations and financial performance.

We expect that our information systems and those of our third-party service providers, vendors and suppliers will continue to experience such attacks in the future, which could include disruptions to our supply chain system.

filingRisks.title: Regulation and legal exposure
filingRisks.detail: The filing reports that in addition, the company may face audits or investigations by one or more government agencies relating to its compliance with applicable laws and regulations.
evidence: In addition, we may face audits or investigations by one or more government agencies relating to our compliance with applicable laws and regulations.

Significant claims or events, regulatory changes, a substantial rise in costs of health care or costs to maintain our insurance or the failure to maintain adequate insurance coverage could have an adverse impact on our financial condition and results of operations.
